ios.desc:
Your music, from your own server, everywhere. play:Sub plays your Navidrome, Gonic, Subsonic or other Subsonic-compatible library on iPhone, iPad and Mac, in the car with CarPlay, on Chromecast or through your server's Jukebox - streamed in the quality you choose, or offline.

NEW: AUTO SYNC
• Keeps your starred songs, albums and artists, your newest albums or any playlist on your device, automatically
• Choose per source: Download to keep it, or Cache to let it make room for other music

NEVER LET THE MUSIC STOP
• Auto DJ keeps playing when the queue runs out, with music related to what you started
• Or pick an Auto Play mode: favorite artists, random albums, newest additions, artist radio, decade radio and more

SERVERS
• Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic, Ampache, Funkwhale, Booksonic, Subsonic and more
• OpenSubsonic support
• Multiple servers, with easy switching
• Some servers need their Subsonic API turned on

AUDIO
• FLAC, ALAC, AAC, MP3, OGG, WAV, AIFF, WEBM and more, without transcoding
• Lossless and gapless playback, hi-res up to 24-bit/192 kHz
• 10-band equalizer with presets, crossfade and ReplayGain
• Playback speed from 0.5x to 2x
• Audio Visualizer, and lyrics where your server has them

PLAY ANYWHERE
• iPhone, iPad and Mac (Apple silicon): any orientation, multitasking and resizable windows
• CarPlay: your library, the play queue, server switching, and album and artist pages with play and shuffle buttons
• Chromecast and Subsonic Jukebox
• AirPlay, Bluetooth, headphone and car controls, Lock Screen and Control Center
• Home Screen widgets you can play from
• Picks up again after phone calls

OFFLINE
• Download music to keep it, or let the cache fill and trim itself
• Played tracks are cached automatically, upcoming tracks preloaded
• Download or cache single tracks or whole albums, artists, folders and playlists
• Cached audio is upgraded to a better bitrate when available
• Background downloads
• The same app offline: browse, play, star and edit playlists, synced when you are back online

BROWSE AND DISCOVER
• Artists, albums, songs, folders, genres, decades and record labels
• Playlists, favorites, podcasts, audiobooks and bookmarks
• Recently added, frequently played and random
• Artist radio, top songs and similar artists
• Internet radio: your server's stations, plus 20,000+ from radio-browser.info
• Search everything, filter by media folder or show only starred
• Long-press anything for the actions that fit

PLAYLISTS AND FAVORITES

quotes.text:
For anyone who wants to stream music from a server they run, I strongly recommend my setup. I run Navidrome [0] on my media machine, and then connect to it via Jamstash [1] on my desktop browser or play:Sub [2] on my iPhone. Lots of features, few bugs, pretty easy.

[0] https://github.com/navidrome/navidrome

[1] https://jamstash.com

[2] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/play-sub-music-streamer/id955329386

This. I have Ampache set up in my cloud server, data storage mounted from my house. Works like a charm.

Also amazing play:Sub iOS app (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/play-sub-music-streamer/id955329386) supports Ampache API and has quite decent UI. All this allows me to have my music anywhere I go

quotes.text:
Yes!

I purchase music from Bandcamp, where everything can be downloaded DRM-free.
https://bandcamp.com/

I have a VPS with Navidrome as a web streamer/front-end.
Navidrome also provides an API compatible with Subsonic.
https://github.com/navidrome/navidrome

For iOS, play:Sub has a pretty nice UI, streams everything from the server, transcoded on-the-fly from FLAC to Opus.
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/play-sub-music-streamer/id955329386

It's quite a joy to use and it feels good that the artists (especially lesser known) get paid more than through spotify/apple. I also throw a little bit of money at the Navidrome dev every month.

quotes.text:
Airsonic: https://github.com/airsonic/airsonic

Airsonic (like Subsonic before it) lets me have the best of both worlds by automatically transcoding my FLAC library to VBR MP3 on the fly when I stream music to my phone over LTE. It's a Java webapp (.war), and the standalone exe version just bundles (iirc) Jetty. I run it in Tomcat9 just as well.

My client recommendations are play:Sub on iOS and DSub on Android:
https://apps.apple.com/us/app/play-sub-music-streamer/id955329386
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=github.daneren2005.dsub
